invariants.broken_note: NOTHING WAS REFUTED THIS ROUND, and that is worth stating rather than passing over. R7.4 refuted a claim it had shipped as PROVED. Here the three affected PROVED claims all survive on their propositions and carry corrections to their EVIDENCE — GPT-5.6 ruled explicitly that IMPACT-TRANSFER-NONADDITIVE should not be refuted for a false supporting assertion about a different check, and the same reasoning was applied to the other two. A reader should check that reasoning rather than accept it: the risk of this move is that `correct the evidence, keep the status` becomes the default escape from a refutation.
invariants.note: THE ROUND'S RESULT IS THAT A FAULT MODEL IS WORTH MORE THAN THE FINDING THAT PRODUCED IT. GPT-5.6 proposed M1–M8 in the same audit that found the monotonicity hole. Running them against the tree they were auditing killed FOUR MORE THINGS: both guards of operational() were individually deletable with every check still green (M3 and its mirror), the declared-additive fold was reached only where every consequent was ∅ so `union the consequents` and `return ∅` were the same function (M9), and the unruled-kind branch had no additive edge anywhere to reach it (M10, the unsound one — it reports `nothing affected` for an impact nobody classified). The R7.4 lesson was `choose a discriminating control`; the R7.5 lesson is that a CONJUNCTION needs a control per conjunct, and that a branch reached only where its output is ∅ is not reached.
retyped: IMPACT-TRANSFER-NONADDITIVE: stays PROVED, on GPT-5.6's explicit ruling. Its PROPOSITION was never in question; one supporting sentence in its evidence — about a monotonicity gate — was false, and is corrected in place rather than by refutation.
IMPACT-NARROWING-NOT-OPERATIONAL: stays PROVED, proposition intact, with the record that R7.4's fixture could not discriminate the two guards implementing it.
IMPACT-UNKNOWN-TOP: stays PROVED, with the record that one of its four declared situations had no witness edge at R7.4.
SUPPORT-REACH-CONSERVATIVE-TYPED: stays OPEN, per GPT-5.6, and stops being treated as waiting on implementation. Its third layer is now IMPACT-PRECISION-REALIZED.

transition.operation: audit-repair round, and the first whose repair mechanism found more than the audit did. The monotonicity check moved from comparing authored rules to ENUMERATING the executable transformer (32 inputs, 243 comparable pairs, 1024 join pairs per edge). The semantics was extracted to scripts/impact-kernel.mjs so a fault model can be registered as DATA rather than string-patched into a tracked file. A new gate, scripts/check-impact-mutants.mjs, holds 12 registered mutants and decides equivalence by extensional signature over the finite domain. Three control edges added — E7 and E8 discriminate the two guards of operational(), which R7.4's fixture failed BOTH of at one edge; E9 is the first declared-additive edge in the fixture. FOUR NEW CLAIMS AND ONE UNASKED-FOR FINDING: ⊤ is absorbing under exact-match semantics, so every discharged narrowing in this fixture is dead from every source seed.
